description: This file defines data models (TokenResponse and MeResponse) for parsing JSON responses from an API in a Flutter application, including factory constructors for JSON deserialization.

classes.name: TokenResponse
classes.description: Represents authentication token data received from API, including access and refresh tokens with their expiration durations.

classes.name: MeResponse
classes.description: Represents user information and session expiry data received from API.

methods.name: TokenResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON map into a TokenResponse instance.

methods.name: MeResponse.fromJson
methods.description: Deserializes JSON map into a MeResponse instance.
